description: This file contains the definition of the InterestRate class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically in the Financial calculation namespace. It implements methods to compute effective interest rates and nominal interest rates based on given inputs, including validation and error handling.

classes.name: InterestRate
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate the effective and nominal interest rates based on various financial inputs.

methods.name: effective
methods.description: Calculates and returns the effective interest rate from the nominal rate and compounding periods per year. Returns an error message if validation fails or inputs are invalid.

methods.name: nominal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the nominal interest rate from the effective rate and number of periods per year. Handles validation and errors similarly.
